basic_details.post_name: Ayurveda Therapist Male, Multi-purpose worker (NCD ISM), Ayurveda Nurse, and other posts

age_limit.details: The age limit is not exceeding 40 years as on 07-10-2026. Persons born on or after 07-10-1986 can apply or attend the interview.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | ayurveda therapist male: Ayurveda Therapist Course conducted by Govt. of Keralam/ DAME/ Ayurveda Panchakarma Technician Course with 1 year duration conducted by CCRAS Cheruthuruthy. | multi-purpose worker (ncd ism): ANM or above with Computer Knowledge (MS Office). | ayurveda nurse: ANM Course certificate, 1 Year certificate in Ayurveda Nursing (DAME). | multi-purpose health worker (mphw): BSc nursing approved by recognized University / GNM Nursing approved by recognized Nursing School with Kerala Nursing & midwife council registration. | yoga demonstrator: BNYS / MSc (Yoga) / MPhil (Yoga) from a recognized University / PG Diploma in Yoga of Minimum One Year duration from a recognized University / approved Certificate course of One year duration in Yoga from a recognized University/ Govt. Department. / YCB Certificate. Skill test eligibility is must for all qualifications. | multi-purpose worker (physiotherapy unit): Physiotherapy Assistant or ANM with Computer Knowledge.

how_to_apply: Download the detailed notification and application form from the official website https://www.nam.kerala.gov.in/.
Fill up all relevant fields of the application form compulsorily.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates to prove age, qualifications, and any other relevant documents.
Enclose the equivalency certificate if possessing an equivalent qualification.
Place the application in a sealed envelope.
Submit the filled application directly or through post to The District Programme Manager Office, National AYUSH Mission, Asramam PO, Kollam, 691002 on or before 17/10/2026 up to 5 PM.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted in a sealed envelope either directly or through post; E-mail applications will not be accepted. Incomplete or incorrect application forms will be summarily rejected. Applications without copies of certificates will not be accepted and will be rejected. Failure to submit an equivalency certificate for equivalent qualifications will result in rejection. Candidates must possess a personal E-mail ID and Mobile Number for all communications regarding the recruitment process. Furnishing false, tampered, or fabricated information will lead to rejection of the candidature at any stage.

content_sections.heading: NAM Kollam – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting?: National AYUSH Mission, District Programme Management & Supporting Unit (DPMSU), Kollam Which posts?: Ayurveda Therapist Male, Multi-purpose worker (NCD ISM), Ayurveda Nurse, Multi-Purpose Health Worker (MPHW), Yoga Demonstrator, Multi-purpose worker (Physiotherapy Unit) How many vacancies?: Anticipatory Who can apply?: Candidates meeting post-specific educational qualifications and age limits not exceeding 40 years as on 07-10-2026 Application start date: 07-10-2026 Last date: 17-10-2026 up to 5 PM Application mode: Offline (Direct or through post) Job location: Kollam District, Kerala

content_sections.heading: NAM Kollam Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is not exceeding 40 years as on 07-10-2026. Persons born on or after 07-10-1986 can apply or attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: NAM Kollam Selection Process
content_sections.text: If 20 or more candidates apply for the same post, a screening test will also be conducted. Intimation regarding interview, written examination, and other matters will be sent through the E-mail provided by the applicant.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Kollam
content_sections.text: Download the detailed notification and application form from the official website https://www.nam.kerala.gov.in/ . Fill up all relevant fields of the application form compulsorily. Attach self-attested copies of certificates to prove age, qualifications, and any other relevant documents. Enclose the equivalency certificate if possessing an equivalent qualification. Place the application in a sealed envelope. Submit the filled application directly or through post to The District Programme Manager Office, National AYUSH Mission, Asramam PO, Kollam, 691002 on or before 17/10/2026 up to 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates to prove age Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Equivalency certificate (if applicable) Any other relevant documents specified in the notification

content_sections.heading: NAM Kollam Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in a sealed envelope either directly or through post; E-mail applications will not be accepted. Incomplete or incorrect application forms will be summarily rejected. Applications without copies of certificates will not be accepted and will be rejected. Failure to submit an equivalency certificate for equivalent qualifications will result in rejection. Candidates must possess a personal E-mail ID and Mobile Number for all communications regarding the recruitment process. Furnishing false, tampered, or fabricated information will lead to rejection of the candidature at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. What is NAM Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NAM Kollam Recruitment 2026 is a notification issued by the National AYUSH Mission Kollam to hire staff for various posts including Ayurveda Therapist, Nurse, MPHW, Yoga Demonstrator, and Multi-purpose worker on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NAM Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The vacancies are notified as anticipatory vacancies across various AYUSH institutions in Kollam District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NAM Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 17-10-2026 up to 5 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for NAM Kollam posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 40 years as on 07-10-2026. Persons born on or after 07-10-1986 can apply or attend the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NAM Kollam posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for NAM Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in a sealed envelope directly or through post to the District Programme Manager Office.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The District Programme Manager Office, National AYUSH Mission, Asramam PO, Kollam, 691002.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be an exam or interview?
faq.answer: If 20 or more candidates apply for the same post, a screening test will be conducted, along with an interview.
